assertions.evidence: transcript read SKILL.md, references/decision-model-limits.md, references/decisions-api.md, references/models.md

The code calls the Decisions API and reads numeric probabilities (src/review-classifier.ts: readCategory returns probabilities; classifyReview uses decide()), and README.md states “There is no generated answer to string-match.”

Spam and abusive are modeled as a single choice question (src/review-question.ts has type: "choice" with criteria { spam, abusive, fine }); README.md says “This is one choice… If both labels must be returned simultaneously, use separate binary questions instead.”

Thresholding is implemented in code via gateReview(decision, minimumProbability), comparing the winning label’s probability to per-label thresholds (src/review-classifier.ts); tests exercise these thresholds (src/review-classifier.test.ts).
